_comment: README app categories, in display order. generate_patches_readme.py groups apps by package name; an app missing here is listed under 'Other' and the script prints a warning, so add every new app to one category. Every app gets a Google Play link in the README unless its package is in notOnGooglePlay (no Play listing in any region; checked 2026-10-22 for AL, US, DE, GB and IN - some apps, e.g. Flashscore, are region-locked and still count as on Play). This bundle ships Tasker only (2026-11-18).
